Corollary
[Compactness of based thick hyperbolic manifolds] 1. 9.1.7\group thurston.ch09.convergenceSource: thurston:page-0244 The space of complete hyperbolic manifolds equipped with a base frame in the $\epsilon $-thick part is compact in the geometric topology.
